summary: PR-1745 rewrites payments' required_approvals as a single conditional expression; the logic looks unchanged and the process records (ticket, independent code review on the final commit, passing CI) are in order. However, the PAY-1 dual-control evidence of record is an exhaustive formal proof that covers this exact function, and under LAP-1 any edit beyond comments or formatting lapses it until new evidence of the same strength is provided. The only fresh evidence is a control test over a fixed amount grid, which is weaker than the proof. Because evidence that LAP-1 requires is missing, the change is rejected; it can be resubmitted with the proof re-run against the new commit.
